lines.text: Many learners say: I was stolen my wallet.
The wallet is stolen, not you.

data.why: The wallet is stolen, not you.

native.tip: ‘나는 지갑을 도둑맞았다’를 그대로 옮기기 쉬워요. 도둑맞은 물건이 주어예요! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “My wallet was stolen.”
native.caption: “I was stolen my wallet”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 한국어는 ‘나는 지갑을 도둑맞았다’처럼 사람을 주어로 말하지만, 영어는 도둑맞은 물건이 주어가 돼요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “My wallet was stolen.” Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: The thing is stolen, not you. Say “My wallet was stolen.”
en.caption: Do you say “I was stolen my wallet” in English? 😅 In English the thing is the subject, and you are not “stolen”! “My wallet was stolen” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
